notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo Offer
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33025535/9aee4a6dfbcfddb00ef4dab5d42bc6a35f494d94.png[/img]

[h1][b]Steam Next Fest has launched![/b][/h1]

We have a new [u]special Next Fest demo[/u] of [b]Restaurant Owner: A Restaurant Simulator[/b] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3429100/Restaurant_Owner_A_Restaurant_Simulator_Demo/][b]demo[/b][/url]. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3429100/Restaurant_Owner_A_Restaurant_Simulator_Demo/


If you like relaxing, casual simulation-management games try out the demo, as the full game is coming out very soon.

Have fun playing,
CreativeForge Games


Just to let you know, our friends from FreeMind also have some funny demos. One of them is [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3429100/Restaurant_Owner_A_Restaurant_Simulator_Demo/]Purrrifiers: Cleaning Chaos[/url]. Check it out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3429100/Restaurant_Owner_A_Restaurant_Simulator_Demo/][b]HERE[/b][/url]

notes.title: Restaurant Owner: Prologue v0.1.3 RELEASE
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes:[/b]

1. [b]New Feature: Notification Bar[/b]
   - Players will now receive a visual notification when there is a new review or payment.  

2. [b]Bug Fixes: Review Screen [/b]
   - Fixed an issue where the review screen startup window did not display correctly.  

3. [b]Improvements: Game Mechanics Explanations[/b]
   - Added clearer and more detailed explanations for game mechanics to enhance player understanding.  

[i]Please keep sharing your ideas, thoughts, and experiences with us. They truly make a difference. We’re excited to keep growing and improving the game together with you! 😊

Thank you for being part of our amazing community![/i]

Don’t forget to join our Discord channel to connect with the community and share your feedback directly. You can also create tickets for suggestions or report issues. We’d love to hear from you!
